# Theseus

> > National digital repository for Finnish universities of applied sciences (ammattikorkeakoulu) theses, research publications, and academic works.

Theseus is operated by Arene ry (Rectors' Conference of Finnish Universities of Applied Sciences) and serves as the central platform for accessing student theses and research from all Finnish polytechnic institutions. The repository supports open access to academic publications across multiple disciplines and institutions.

## Key Topics

- Finnish universities of applied sciences (ammattikorkeakoulu)
- Academic thesis repository
- Open access publications
- Arene ry (Rectors' Conference)
- Student research and theses
- Polytechnic education in Finland
- Digital library services
- Bachelor's and Master's theses
- Research database
- Finnish higher education
- Multi-institutional repository
- Academic publishing platform

## Main Repository

- [Ammattikorkeakoulut - Theseus](https://www.theseus.fi): Homepage of the Theseus repository providing access to theses and research publications from Finnish universities of applied sciences
